name: prairie dog
mana cost: {1}{W}
types: creature squirrel
power toughness: 2/2
static: lifelink
activated[1]: {4}{W}: until end of turn, if you would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put that many plus one +1/+1 counters on it instead.
triggered: at the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
